Here are the extracted quantitative parameters and values from the text:

1. Tumor size at inoculation: 500–1,000 mm³ (around day 10).
2. Time for complete rejection of EG7 tumors: 6–8 days.
3. Tumor growth period after adoptive transfer: 3 days.
4. Early rejection phase: days 3–4 after adoptive transfer.
5. Late rejection phase: days 5–6 after adoptive transfer.
6. Expansion of OT1-GFP cells within EG7 tumors: 1.8% ± 0.3 of total cells; P = 0.005.
7. Number of EG7 and EL4 tumor cells injected: 10^6 cells.
8. Time after injection for adoptive transfer: 8–10 days.
9. Number of purified naive CD8^+ cells transferred: 10^7 cells.
10. Mean ± SD for tumor size evolution: n = 5 independent experiments.
11. Density of OT1-GFP cells calculation: number of OT1-GFP cells per mm².
12. Expression of activation markers (CD69 and CD62L) analyzed by flow cytometry: mean ± SD, n = 3–6.
13. IFN-γ production analysis: mean ± SD, n = 5.
14. Statistical significance indicators: *, P < 0.05; **, P < 0.01; ***, P < 0.001.
